fees.notes: International total payable fee for the entire programme per UOC official International Fees Structure (includes registration RM2,000, processing RM1,500, administration RM8,000/RM5,000 ODL, EMGS RM2,800 and resource fees); per-year amount not published. Source: https://cyberjaya.edu.my/admission/fees/international-fees-structure (fetched 2026-09-18)

requirements.general: Any of these: A bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy (Bachelor's Degree Level): A bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 or equivalent, as accepted by the University; or A bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy or equivalent (Bachelor's Degree Level): A bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy or equivalent with minimum CGPA between 2.00 and 2.50 can be accepted subject to rigorous internal assessment. English Proficiency (For International Students): Minimum TOEFL score of 550 (PBT) or 80 (IBT) or Minimum IELTS score of 6.0 or any other equivalent qualification recognised by the Malaysian government, acceptable to the University.
